tools.name: databricks_list_accounts
tools.description: Lista os workspaces Databricks conectados a este install — host, label.

tools.name: databricks_current_user
tools.description: Identifica o usuário do PAT no workspace (whoami via SCIM Me). Útil pra confirmar qual conta/host está conectado e validar o token.

tools.name: databricks_list_warehouses
tools.description: Lista os SQL warehouses do workspace (id, name, state, cluster_size, warehouse_type). Use o `id` em databricks_run_sql (ou deixe o run_sql escolher um RUNNING automaticamente).

tools.name: databricks_get_warehouse
tools.description: Detalha um ou mais SQL warehouses por id. Aceita lista (`ids`).

tools.name: databricks_run_sql
tools.description: Executa uma instrução SQL num SQL warehouse (Statement Execution API). Retorna colunas + linhas quando termina dentro do wait_timeout; senão devolve statement_id + state pra polling via databricks_get_statement. Se `warehouse_id` não for informado, escolhe um warehouse RUNNING automaticamente. PREFI

tools.name: databricks_get_statement
tools.description: Status + resultado de um ou mais statements por id (polling de queries longas que voltaram PENDING/RUNNING do run_sql). Aceita lista (`statement_ids`).

tools.name: databricks_cancel_statement
tools.description: Cancela um ou mais statements em execução por id. Aceita lista (`statement_ids`).

tools.name: databricks_list_catalogs
tools.description: Lista os catálogos do Unity Catalog visíveis ao PAT (name, comment, owner).

tools.name: databricks_list_schemas
tools.description: Lista os schemas (databases) de um catálogo Unity. Informe `catalog_name`.

tools.name: databricks_list_tables
tools.description: Lista as tabelas de um schema Unity (name, table_type, data_source_format). Informe `catalog_name` e `schema_name`.

tools.name: databricks_get_table
tools.description: Detalha uma ou mais tabelas (colunas, tipos) por nome completo `catalog.schema.table`. Aceita lista (`full_names`).

tools.name: show_version
tools.description: Show the current MCP platform and adapter versions.

tools.name: report_bug
tools.description: Report a bug, missing feature, or send feedback. Include the conversation array with recent messages for reproduction.

tools.name: connect
tools.description: Returns connection status and URLs. When all providers are connected, returns authenticated:true and empty pending[]. When credentials are missing, returns connect_url for the toolkit and per-install URLs.

tools.name: toolkit_info
tools.description: Returns the current toolkit state: installed MCPs, their connection status, the accounts connected to each one, and how many catalog tools each exposes.

tools.name: marketplace
tools.description: The official mcp.ai marketplace — the in-platform catalog of every MCP/tool, AND the way to run them. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "p_databricks" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: databricks_list_catalogs · Private data: databricks_current_user, connect, marketplace, authenticate · Public sink: report_bug · Destructive: databricks_run_sql, marketplace.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: databricks_list_catalogs · Private data: databricks_current_user, connect, marketplace, authenticate · Public sink: report_bug · Destructive: databricks_run_sql, marketplace

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
